name: 产品多角度网格

prompt_template.subject: {product_description}
prompt_template.grid: 2x2 or 3x3 equal squares, or one main hero with a smaller confirmed-variation grid
prompt_template.evidence: use only user-confirmed angles, colors, names, SKUs and product structures
prompt_template.quality: catalog photography, uniform lighting across all cells

overrides.variation: front, side, back, top-down, 3/4 angle views
same product only in user-confirmed colors, identical 3/4 angle, scale, structure and lighting
overrides.grid: 2x2 or 2x3 equal grid, or main confirmed color as a large hero left with up to four confirmed colors in a 2x2 grid right

overrides.variation: each cell shows different product feature with label and icon
overrides.grid: hero image left + 4 smaller shots right column

overrides.variation: before/after or product vs competitor in side-by-side grid

category_tips.beauty: show bottle angle, cap detail, texture close-up, and open product
category_tips.electronics: show front face, side ports, back panel, and included accessories
category_tips.fashion: show front view, back view, detail close-up, and fabric texture
category_tips.food: show packaging front, back nutrition, open product, and serving suggestion
category_tips.home: show full product, detail angle, material texture, and in-context shot
category_tips.sports: show product front, side profile, sole/bottom, and action usage shot
category_tips.accessories: for bags and accessories, preserve exact pocket, strap, closure and hardware structure across confirmed colorways; render exact confirmed color names and SKU labels

examples: 2x2 product grid. {product} shown from 4 angles: front, side, back, top-down. Clean white background per cell. Thin borders. Uniform studio lighting, 2000x2000px

3x3 color variation grid. Same {product} in 9 user-confirmed colors, identical 3/4 angle. Exact confirmed color labels and SKU values. Clean white cells, subtle drop shadow. Professional catalog, 2000x2000px

Catalog colorway page, square 1:1. Main confirmed color product as a large hero on the left occupying 46%, with four smaller user-confirmed colorways in a 2x2 grid on the right. Identical 3/4 angle, structure, scale and lighting. Exact confirmed color names and SKU labels below each item. No invented colors, identifiers, materials or structural changes.

composition_rules.layout: 网格布局 2×2 / 3×3，或主色产品左侧大图 + 右侧 2×2 已确认配色网格
composition_rules.product_ratio: 等分网格每格 40%；主次配色布局主产品 42-48%、小产品每格 24-30%

text_rules.labels: 每格可加角度或配色短标签，11-16pt 现代无衬线半粗体，#111111，风格统一
text_rules.sku: 配色页可在色名下加 10-13pt 现代无衬线常规体 #3A3A3A 的 SKU；色名与 SKU 必须由用户确认
text_rules.limit: 单格最多两行文字；不得生成未确认颜色、型号、货号或价格

pitfalls: 各格光线色温不一致（所有格子固定同一灯位、曝光和白平衡）
产品在各格大小不一（等分网格固定产品占比；主次布局只允许主产品更大）
角度重复没有信息增量（多角度模式按正面、侧面、背面、俯视分配）
生成未确认颜色或 SKU（配色模式只读取用户确认的颜色名单、色名和货号）
不同配色的口袋、肩带或五金结构漂移（所有配色复用同一产品结构参考）
